summary.goal: Merge InterviewerService and PlannerLead into a single TendInterviewerService with unified tool set, project-scoped channels, and forge event subscription.

acceptance_criteria.description: TendInterviewerService created as persistent relay service (RelayClient, not spawn)
Tool set includes ideation tools: spawn_specialist, read_blocks, update_understanding, update_synthesis
Tool set includes planner tools: add_step, edit_step, read_plan
Tool set includes bridge tools: graduate_blocks, start_execution
Tool set includes interaction tools: ask_user_question, spawn_agent, release_agent
One conversation history per project (combining all context)
Context focus enrichment: when user's current_focus changes, next AI invocation includes focus details in system prompt
Forge SSE subscription: Interviewer receives forge events and makes editorial trickle decisions (trickle milestones, suppress routine, summarize completions)
Blocking forge events (agent needs input) trigger immediate Interviewer invocation
System prompt follows structure from implementation doc (project state, pending events, specialist insights, rules)
AI maintains one voice — never reveals specialists or internal agents

observations: This is the largest new backend piece
InterviewerService (packages/ideation/src/interviewer/service.ts, ~965 lines) has session management, tool calling, specialist spawning
PlannerLead (packages/server/src/relay/planner-lead.ts) has plan editing, relay messaging, agent orchestration
Both use Anthropic SDK with tool calling and manage per-channel conversation history
Merging: combine tool sets, unify channels to #project-{id}, add forge SSE subscription for trickle layer
The trickle layer is editorial — the AI decides what to surface based on its prompt rules, not hard-coded event filtering
Conversation history combines ideation context (blocks, specialists, understanding) + planner context (steps, dependencies) + forge context (running agents, results)
questions: Should we maintain separate conversation histories per tool category or truly unify?
How do we handle migration of existing sessions/plans to projects?
Should specialists continue to exist or be absorbed into the unified Interviewer?

steps.title: Create TendInterviewerService shell
steps.description: Copy InterviewerService structure from packages/ideation/src/interviewer/service.ts (~965 lines). Create TendInterviewerService as persistent RelayClient service (NOT spawn). Initialize RelayClient with agentId 'tend-interviewer', listen on #project-{id} channels (replacing #ideation-{sessionId} + #plan-{planId}). Keep Anthropic SDK integration pattern, conversation history management.

steps.title: Merge ideation tool set
steps.description: Copy tools from packages/ideation/src/interviewer/tools.ts: spawn_specialist (unchanged), read_blocks (was read_session — adapt to read from project.session_id), update_understanding, update_synthesis. Preserve specialist spawning pattern (lazy, AI-driven, session-scoped lifecycle).

steps.title: Merge planner tool set
steps.description: Copy tools from packages/server/src/relay/planner-lead-tools/: add_step, edit_step, read_plan, list_steps. Adapt to read from project.plan_id instead of accepting plan_id as param. Keep existing validation logic.

steps.title: Add bridge tools
steps.description: Create two new tools: graduate_blocks (calls POST /api/projects/:id/graduate with block_ids array), start_execution (calls POST /api/forge/runs with project.plan_id, project.config.scopes, project.config.execution_policy). Return artifact references from both.

steps.title: Add interaction tools
steps.description: Copy from planner-lead: ask_user_question (surfaces blocking questions via attention system), spawn_agent (relay spawning pattern), release_agent (cleanup). Keep existing question queue and agent tracking logic.

steps.title: Implement context focus enrichment
steps.description: Read project.current_focus from ProjectStorage on each invocation. If focus exists (focus_type: 'step', focus_id: 'step-abc'), enrich system prompt with focused entity details. For step focus: include step title, status, AC, dependencies, agent status, recent events. For scope focus: include scope summary, progress, active steps.

steps.title: Implement forge SSE subscription
steps.description: Subscribe to GET /api/forge/runs/:id/events SSE stream on behalf of Interviewer. Buffer non-blocking events (step progress, agent spawned, PR created) in pending context queue. For blocking events (agent_needs_input, gate_reached), trigger immediate Interviewer invocation. Copy SSE subscription pattern from existing event listeners.

steps.title: Write system prompt template
steps.description: Implement system prompt per implementation doc structure: project state (name, initiative, phase), pending forge events (from buffer), specialist insights queue, current_focus enrichment, rules (one voice, trickle milestones not routine, propose graduation at threshold, adapt to focus). Prompt should guide editorial trickle decisions.

steps.title: Unify conversation history
steps.description: Merge conversation history management from InterviewerService and PlannerLead. One history per project stored in project_messages table. Each message tagged with channel_id ('main' or 'agent-{agentId}'), role (user/assistant/system), metadata (block_refs, step_refs, attention_level). History combines all context: blocks, specialists, steps, forge events.

architect.merge_strategy: combined tool set, project-scoped channels, one history per project
architect.trickle_logic: prompt-driven editorial decisions, not code-driven filtering

trickle_rules: Suppress routine (individual test passes, dependency installs)

system_prompt_structure: Pending events (forge updates queued for trickle)
Current focus (what user is looking at)
Rules (maintain one voice, never reveal internal agents)
